string_table.string: Chicos, ¿soy el único imbécil o es que nadie más lo ha pillado? ¿De qué iba?// changed 'only one dumb here' to 'only dumbass here' to better reflect rough bandit tone, 'is everyone else didn't get it' to 'did nobody else get it' to better flow / 'nobody' for more informal tone, replaced ',' after 'get it' to '?' to better tone
¡Vaya, qué viejo eres! ¡Podrías haberme hablado de Stirlitz!// 'mould' to 'geezer' to better reflect 'old joker'. replaced ',' after geezer with '!' to better flow
Ja, ja. Qué gracioso. Me parto y me mondo.// 'I just can't' to 'that's a real knee-slapper' to reinforce sarcasm
Mm, te llega al alma...// replaced 'ugh' with 'mn' to reinforce contemplative tone, added 'the' before 'soul' for emphasis, ellipsis after 'soul' to further reinforce contemplative tone
Sí, Bombón. Si te portaras así en la cárcel, ya te habrían follado hace tiempo.// removed 'the' before 'prison' and replaced 'have been' with 'be' to reinforce bandit colloquial tone
Con eso deberían formarse cascadas...// idk what 'forestfall' means. if it's to evoke sadness, then i replaced the whole statement to reflect that

Cuando estábamos en el reformatorio no teníamos nada con qué entretenernos.// im assumming he meant he was in prison as a kid, replaced with us-central slang for juvenile-detention called 'juvie.' open to edits on this to make it less us-centric

¡No, no, no! ¡No es eso, ni de cerca! ¡No, estás de broma!// replaced ',' after last 'no' in trio for emphasis and edited capitalized subsequent 'that' to make seperate clause, replaced ',' after inch with '!' to reinforce tone, capitalized 'no' subsequently for seperate clause. contracted 'you' and 'are' to reinforce bandit colloquial tone.

No, no, bueno... chicos, esperad. Está claro que no lo he pillado, ¿era una canción? ¡Que le den a esa música!// replaced ',' after second 'no' to '-', replaced ',' after 'well' with ellipsis, replaced ',' after wait with '.' to better convey pause. replaced 'music' with song' in first instance to better differentiate dislike this particular song. replaced 'it' with 'that' before 'song' to better convey that the songs not still occuring in conversation

¡Gha-ga-ga-ga-gaaa-ja-ja-jaja-ja! ¡Buena esa, Nudillos, de verdad, jurado!// removed ',' before 'pal' to better flow, replaced 'pal' with 'knuckles' to better convey rough-and-tumble, positive nickname

string.text: ¡Ja, ja, ja! ¡No, eres todo un comediante, de verdad!

string_table.string: ¡Gha-gag-agha-gA-gah, chico malo, joder, chico muy malo!// changed 'demon' to 'bad-boy' to reinforce rough-and-tumble tone

string.text: ¡Me estoy partiendo el culo, chicos! ¡Jaaaaa, ja, ja, ja, ja, ja, jaaaa, jaa!
¡Ja, ja, ja, ja, ja, ja, ja!
